title: People you look after
lead: See at a glance how your loved ones are doing today: their check-in, water and any warning signs.

empty.title: No one yet
empty.body: Ask your parent or relative to open Living Dose on their phone, go to Account → Family helpers, and send you their invite link.
empty.own: Want someone to look after you? Invite them from Account → Family helpers.

urgentBody: They said: {{what}}. Please call them now. If they don't answer or feel faint, call 112.
unwellBody: A quick call could help. If they've felt unwell for several days, suggest a doctor.
quietBody: A gentle reminder from you can help them keep going.
loadError: We couldn't load your family. Please check your connection.

join.title: {{name}} wants you to look after them
join.body: You'll see {{name}}'s daily check-in, any warning signs, how much water they've had and their streak. You won't see their answers to the health check, their meals or their private notes.
join.notFound: This invite link doesn't work. Please ask for a new one.
join.used: This invite link has already been used. Please ask for a new one.
join.expired: This invite link has expired (links last 7 days). Please ask for a new one.
join.own: This is your own invite link. Send it to the family member you'd like to look after you.
join.setup: Family helpers aren't switched on yet. Please try again later.
join.demoSelf: Demo mode: you're accepting your own invite so you can see how it looks.

account.title: Family helpers
account.intro: Let a son, daughter or carer see how you're doing each day, from their own phone. They see your daily check-in, warning signs, water and streak. Not your health check answers, meals or notes.
account.linkReady: Send this link to your family member. It works once and lasts 7 days.
account.whatsappText: Hi, I'd like you to look after my health on Living Dose. Tap this link to join: {{link}}
account.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
